description: This Go source file defines functions for language label processing and translation prompt generation, including templates for Chinese, Japanese, and generic prompts, as well as a glossary-building helper.

methods.name: prettyLanguageLabel
methods.description: Converts a language code into its human-readable label, e.g., 'en' to 'English', 'zh-CN' to 'Simplified Chinese', or returns the original string if empty.

methods.name: translationPrompt
methods.description: Generates a translation prompt based on source and target language codes and an optional glossary, selecting a template for Chinese, Japanese, or generic prompts.

methods.name: buildGlossaryPrompt
methods.description: Builds a glossary string listing source-target term pairs for the translation process, used to enforce terminology consistency.
